test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

I could not use his laptop as it was password protected.

options.text: His laptop has not been used by me as it is password protected.
His laptop cannot be used by me as it is password protected.
His laptop could not been used by me as it was password protected.
His laptop could not be used by me as it was password protected.

solution:
The correct answer is '**His laptop could not be used by me as it was password protected**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The **subject** of the given sentence is 'I'. 
 
• The **object** of the given sentence is 'His laptop'. 
 
• Since **modal verb** has been used in the **active voice**, therefore, the **passive voice** will follow the given structure:
 
 
• Active Voice - modal verb*(can) *+ V1 
 
• Passive Voice - modal verb*(can)* + be + V3 
 
 
 
• Here, 'could not use' will be changed into 'could not be used' because in 'active to passive' transformation third form of the verb is used.

 ​​
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *His laptop could not be used by me as it was password protected.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Active Voice** का उदाहरण है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Passive Voice **में बदलना है।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का **subject** '**I**' है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का **object** **'His laptop'** है।
 
• चूँकि सक्रिय स्वर में मोडल क्रिया का प्रयोग किया गया है, इसलिए निष्क्रिय स्वर दिए गए ढांचे का पालन करेगा:
 
 
• Active Voice - **modal verb*(can) *+ V₁ **
 
• Passive Voice -** modal verb*(can)* + be + V₃**
 
 
 
 
 
• यहाँ, **'could not use' **को **'could not be used'** में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि** 'active to passive'** परिवर्तन में **verb** के **third form** का उपयोग किया जाता है।
